Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S21 Full census: time to all cards and from card tap to Pre-Round

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U8 With multiple patients loaded, everything above holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-01; UAT 3.3)
  • U7 Tapping a card opens that exact patient's Pre-Round view. (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 5)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given 60 seeded Hospital patients and 60 residents (more than one page)

When Open each list, load every page, tap the last card

Then Every card renders with its fields; tap to Pre-Round time recorded

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): No time target written (Q9); timings recorded for a human

Where it ran: datasets (seeded data sets, list checks) on dev; test method PERF · Performance timing; lane planned in the matrix: manual (not-testable)
